invalid_reason.statement: The preregistered prospective sixth-manifest evaluator required both positive and non-positive actual-advantage classes. During the frozen primary run, class_metrics for the sixth manifest returned valid=false because one of those classes was absent. The result serializer then attempted to read sign_accuracy from that invalid metric object and raised KeyError: sign_accuracy.
invalid_reason.preregistered_rule: invalid if any required fold is missing a positive/non-positive class
invalid_reason.scientific_interpretation: No representation-sufficiency conclusion may be drawn from this run.

observed_failure.location: final result construction for stage2 latent_sign_accuracy_minus_control
observed_failure.cause_inference: class_metrics returns only {valid:false} when either actual-positive or actual-nonpositive class is absent; the failing object was the sixth-manifest latent metric, so the preregistered required prospective fold was class-degenerate.

successor_recommendation: Preregister a new experiment before execution with a prospective manifest-admission/evaluator contract that remains defined under class degeneracy. Do not retrofit this R31 result or reuse its observed sixth-manifest outcome as confirmatory evidence.
